mode.description: solo: agent twin only; paired: agent twin plus a human.

human.description: GitHub login of the paired human.

page.description: Where to page this seat (overrides [notify] target).

seats.description: Seat modes keyed by seat slug (registry seats).

base_url.description: Gateway endpoint including the version path, e.g. https://gateway.example/v1; empty disables the gateway.

secret.description: Name of the secret holding the gateway key (sent as Authorization: Bearer).

api_style.description: Wire format for every model without a styles entry: messages (Anthropic Messages), responses (OpenAI Responses), chat (OpenAI Chat Completions). Empty uses the family default.

styles.description: Wire format overrides as "<model-id or family>=<style>", e.g. "grok-4.7=chat" (model IDs contain dots, so this is a list, not a table).

model.description: Model ID as the provider or gateway names it.

family.description: Model family; inferred from the model ID when empty.

additionalProperties.description: [models.<lane>.<host>]: lane and host IDs from the verb registry.

models.description: Model overrides per lane and host, and the optional AI gateway.

quota_warn_percent.description: doctor warns when LFS storage or bandwidth use reaches this percentage.

media.description: Private bucket for proof media; required on public repos (V3).

retention_days.description: Days to keep proof media before purge; 0 keeps forever.

beneficiaries.description: Beneficiary groups a Goal can name, keyed by slug, with a one-line description.

streak.description: Correction-free merges per layer footprint before agent lanes may self-ship.

approver.description: GitHub login that approves when autonomy does not apply.

authority.description: Decision type or layer to the seat or login that may accept it.

sla_hours.description: Business hours before an open Decision pages its authority and escalates.

provisional_after_hours.description: Business hours before a reversible Decision's recommendation applies provisionally (V8).

escalate_to.description: GitHub login mentioned on escalation (founder B).

target.description: slack: name of the secret holding the webhook URL; email: recipient address; github: login to mention.

issue.description: github channel: issue the mention comment is posted on, as owner/name#number.

smtp_addr.description: email channel: SMTP server as host:port (STARTTLS).

from.description: email channel: sender address, also the SMTP user.

smtp_secret.description: email channel: name of the secret holding the SMTP password.

per_pr_inspect_max.description: Model spend in USD for inspect on one PR across all its cycles.

secret.description: Name of the secret holding the key (WP1.3); never the key itself.

url.description: Provider base URL when not the adapter's default (EU region, self-hosted), e.g. https://eu.posthog.com.

org.description: Provider organization: the Sentry organization slug.

project.description: Provider project: the PostHog project ID, the Sentry project ID, or the owner/name GitHub baselines read (default: the current repository).

transport.description: Figma only: rest (personal access token, the default) or mcp (the remote MCP server, opt-in; the secret is an OAuth access token).

integrations.description: External integrations keyed by name. Values name secrets; they never hold them.

platforms.description: Platforms the product ships on, e.g. web, ios, android.

upstream_checks.description: Existing product CI check names the merge gate also requires.

floors.description: Floor thresholds; CONSTRAINTS.md documents each one.

tz.description: IANA time zone for business hours.

business_hours.description: Business days and hours, e.g. Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00.

app_id.description: GitHub App ID of the bot identity (created by init --identity).

app_slug.description: GitHub App slug; the App's login is <slug>[bot].

broker.description: Token broker workflow file in this repo that mints App installation tokens for laptops.

machine_user.description: Machine-user login, the fallback bot identity.

machine_user_secret.description: Name of the secret holding the machine user's token.

bot_logins.description: Logins whose reviews never count as a human pass (machine users and other bots).

identity.description: Bot identity for agent lanes and CI (WP1.4).

otlp_endpoint.description: Opt-in: also send traces as OTLP/HTTP JSON to this collector, e.g. https://collector.example:4318. Empty sends nothing.

telemetry.description: Traces of verb runs (WP1.8): a local file by default; nothing leaves the machine unless otlp_endpoint is set.

fleet.description: User-level only: the product repos that status --all and doctor --all iterate.

dev.description: Integration branch; pull requests target it.

rolling.description: Canary snapshot branch; empty when the product has none.

branches.description: The product's branches that play dev, rolling, and main when they have other names (written by init; nothing is renamed).

title: aayudha config
description: Code generated by go generate (internal/verbs/gen) from internal/config; DO NOT EDIT. Layered: user, .aayudha/config.toml, .aayudha/config.local.toml, AAYU_<SECTION>__<KEY>, --set.
